Lorentz force on a charged particle having a charge q, moving with a velocity in a region of uniform electric field and uniform magnetic field , is given by

. ...... (1)

The particle will move along axis if (i) initial velocity is along and net force is either zero or directed along (ii) initial velocity is zero and net force is directed along . A proton with initial velocity placed in an electric field and magnetic field will experience a net force . It moves in a straight line along .
